_doc: Shadower skill definitions (spec #425). Empty until the skill tickets land; each appends inside its own region, and a key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). SH6 #431 moves Double Stab, Steal and Savage Blow here from skills/thief.json (ported, no explicit ranks); SH7 #432 Assaulter (mobility); SH8 #433 Boomerang Step and Band of Thieves; SH9 #434 Ninja Ambush (key ninja_ambush_shadower); SH10 #435 Meso Explosion; SH11 #436 Dark Sight (moved from skills/thief.json and rewritten as a hidden Form) and Assassinate (form_sub); SH12 #437 Smokescreen (safe_zone). The pool is in jobs/shadower.json.

meso_explosion.name: Meso Explosion
meso_explosion.desc: Detonates your whole meso charge on the monsters in front of you: many bags burst at once. The fuller the charge, the harder the blow. It costs no mesos.

text.desc: Needs at least 4 charge pips and 3 monsters in front of you. Spends the whole meso charge (nothing is taken from your mesos) on up to 6 monsters in a burst of bags; each pip spent adds 8% damage.
text.h: {damage_percent}% per bag, {attack_count} bags each on up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}

meso_explosion._tier: Tier A: the WZ has no damage for 4211006, only x 500 -> 1000 (the String's 'Mastery 50% -> 100%'), attackCount 10 -> 20 ('Explode up to'), mobCount 6, the forward box lt/rb (-200,-100)..(0,50) at levels 1-10, (-250,-110)..(0,50) at 11-20, (-300,-120)..(0,50) at 21-30, mpCon (not modelled), the prone2 action, effect (13 frames), hit/0..8 (nine four-frame bursts) and the Use and Hit sounds. Tier C (spec #425 SH-9, SH-10, SH10 #435, GAME_DESIGN 7.134): damage_basis {x, 0.1} so the per-line percent is x / 10 (56 / 78 / 100% at ranks 1 / 4 / 8), a finisher on the Shadower meso charge (min 4 pips, spends all, +8% damage per pip spent), the box cast rule needing 3 monsters, a 6.0 s cooldown (above the 1.0 s meter floor), a 1.0 s prone2 hold (the stance's two frames, 700 + 300 ms), hit art cycling hit/(line mod 9) per line, rarity bonuses. Nothing is ever spent from the mesos (ruling D7). Untuned.
meso_explosion._rarity: Tier C: first-pass SH10 #435 bonuses (spec #425): Rare Meso Up damage x1.2, Epic Wide Explosion area x1.2, Unique Pickpocket keeps 2 pips (meter_keep +2), Legendary Pickpocket plus damage x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.134 and 8.
